Transitions (fade, slide, zoom, wipe), animated texts, colour, blur and pixel effects, speed from ×0.25 to ×4, sound volume and fades. Landscape, portrait or square format, and export of the edit as a WebM video.

WebM or MP4 export up to 1080p and 60 fps, in 16:9, 9:16, 1:1, 4:5, 4:3 or 21:9.
